reason: $147 a month is a lot when I make under $5k a month, and there are no customer results anywhere. I'd maybe poke at a trial, but I'd cancel before day 4 like I do with most tools, so I wouldn't actually pay.
objection: It only sends while I keep an Instagram tab open, so I'd be babysitting Chrome for hours, and three days is not enough time to see any replies before it bills me $147 with no refunds.
would_change_my_mind: A price under $70 a month, or a longer free trial or a refund window, plus real results from people like me who booked actual clients.
